decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor side extension and a rear roof extension incorporating 3 front lights to the existing house, as shown on drawings numbered 326/01, 326/02 and 326/05, received on 10th November 2006, and 326/04 and 326/04, received on 15th December 2006, is recommended for approval as the proposed works would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building, the amenity of neighbouring properties or would detract from the character of the Conservation Area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00 a.m. to 6.00 p.m. on Mondays to Friday and 9.00 a.m.  to 12.30 p.m on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the northern side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The roof lights to be installed in the front roof slope shall have a 'conservation' style and are to be set flush with the plane of the roof.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor rear extension and a rear roof extension incorporating two roof lights to the front of the existing house
